card.name: Time spent before a research verb
card.fires_on: Words that come right before a verb of searching or studying, such as skimming, researching, compiling or studying. Often a time span like weeks, years or minutes after spend, waste or devote.

modes.label: Time spent on a task
modes.description: A time word after spent, waste or devoted, just before an -ing verb about digging through material.
modes.example: Lawrence devoted<< weeks>> to researching the Great Migration.

modes.label: Lead-in to research or searching
modes.description: A linking word or subject right before a verb like skimming, researching or studied.
modes.example: Reporters do not have to waste time<< sk>>imming through endless pages to find out whether

card.writes: It seems to push words that begin with 'por' or 'comb', as in pore over or combing through, and to suppress number words.
card.plain: It marks the spot just before text says someone pored over, combed through or researched something, often after time spent.
